articles.title: Jaborandi terá vasos gigantes de 9,6 metros no Centro de Lazer | G1
articles.standfirst: Idealizado pelo prefeito Silvio Vaz de Almeida e realizado pela Prefeitura de Jaborandi, projeto prevê três grandes vasos, museu e novas estruturas de lazer, esporte e turismo.
articles.summary: Idealizado pelo prefeito Silvio Vaz de Almeida e realizado pela Prefeitura de Jaborandi, projeto prevê três grandes vasos, museu e novas estruturas de lazer, esporte e turismo.
articles.body:
Início das obras em 2026 dos vasos e museu — Foto: Crédito: Divulgação.

A cidade de Jaborandi está transformando o Centro de Lazer Carlos Oscar Vaz de Almeida em um complexo que reúne esporte, lazer, cultura e novos atrativos turísticos. Entre os projetos em execução está a construção de três grandes vasos, com 9,60 metros de altura cada, uma iniciativa idealizada pelo prefeito Silvio Vaz de Almeida e realizada pela Prefeitura de Jaborandi.

Os vasos prometem se tornar um dos principais símbolos do novo espaço. O projeto prevê estruturas com 9,30 metros de diâmetro, construídas em concreto armado com fechamento em placa cimentícia.

Além das dimensões, uma das características que chama a atenção é a possibilidade de os visitantes entrarem nos vasos e subirem até o topo. Cada estrutura contará com uma escada interna, permitindo o acesso ao ponto mais alto.

A ideia faz parte de um projeto mais amplo de transformação do Centro de Lazer Carlos Oscar Vaz de Almeida, que vem recebendo diferentes investimentos para ampliar suas estruturas de esporte, lazer, cultura e turismo.

O projeto arquitetônico dos vasos já foi desenvolvido e conta com imagens em 3D da proposta. Algumas alterações foram realizadas durante a execução. A obra já foi iniciada e a previsão é de conclusão no primeiro semestre de 2027.

O projeto do Centro de Lazer Carlos Oscar Vaz de Almeida reúne diferentes espaços e, por isso, sua dimensão é dividida em quatro áreas principais.

A Área do Lago possui aproximadamente 30 mil metros quadrados e concentra estruturas voltadas ao lazer e à convivência. Já a Área Esportiva , com cerca de 23 mil metros quadrados, reúne a areninha, quadras, campo de grama, pista de corrida e a área do ginásio.

A terceira área é destinada ao museu, com aproximadamente 5.700 metros quadrados. O espaço está em construção e integra o projeto de ampliação das opções culturais do município.

A quarta área é a dos vasos, com aproximadamente 12 mil metros quadrados, onde também estão sendo executados serviços de calçamento e paisagismo.

Projetos 3d — Foto: Crédito: Divulgação.

A transformação do Centro de Lazer está sendo realizada pela Prefeitura de Jaborandi, com investimentos estaduais, federais e municipais. Até o momento, são aproximadamente R$4,5 milhões em recursos estaduais e federais e R$ 3,1 milhões em investimentos municipais.

Os recursos já contemplaram ou estão sendo destinados a uma série de intervenções, como a construção de galerias, revitalização e remodelação do lago, construção da prainha, reforma da pista de caminhada, reforma da pista de corrida e das quadras, além da iluminação das pistas.

Também fazem parte do conjunto de obras a construção da areninha, a continuidade do ginásio de esportes, reforma dos vestiários, construção do museu e dos vasos, calçamento e paisagismo das áreas dos vasos e do museu, construção de banheiros, novas quadras de beach tennis, reforma do bar do lago e construção de estacionamento na Rua Abraão Abdala Azura.

O projeto reúne ainda obras executadas com recursos municipais, incluindo a continuidade do ginásio, os vestiários, banheiros e as quadras de beach tennis.

A transformação do Centro de Lazer não termina com as obras que estão em andamento. Há aproximadamente R$1,5 milhão em recursos estaduais previstos em projetos futuros, destinados à construção de um lago ornamental, iluminação total do Centro de Lazer, novos banheiros, quiosques e estufas.

A proposta é ampliar gradualmente a estrutura do espaço e criar novas possibilidades de utilização para moradores e visitantes.

Um novo espaço de lazer, esporte e turismo

A construção dos vasos e do museu representa uma nova etapa do projeto de transformação do Centro de Lazer Carlos Oscar Vaz de Almeida. A iniciativa, idealizada pelo prefeito Silvio Vaz de Almeida, busca reunir em uma mesma área atrações culturais, espaços esportivos, áreas de convivência e elementos arquitetônicos capazes de criar uma nova referência para o município.

A execução envolve engenheiros de diferentes áreas, responsáveis pela elaboração dos projetos, além de diferentes empresas que já participaram das obras por meio de processos de licitação.

Atualmente, o projeto está concentrado na execução dos vasos e do museu, enquanto outras intervenções já foram concluídas ou seguem em andamento.

Com a conclusão das obras, Jaborandi terá um complexo de lazer cada vez mais estruturado, unindo esporte, natureza, cultura e novos atrativos. Os três vasos, com quase dez metros de altura e acesso interno ao topo, estão entre os elementos que prometem dar uma nova identidade ao espaço e ampliar o potencial turístico da cidade.

articles.title: Festival Geraldo Azevedo 2026: inscrições e prêmios de R$ 13 mil | G1
articles.standfirst: Interessados devem se inscrever através do site do Mapa Cultural. Evento será realizado na Concha Acústica e vai premiar músicas autorais inéditas de artistas de todo o país.
articles.summary: O Festival de Música Geraldo Azevedo encerra inscrições para canções inéditas nesta sexta-feira, com prêmios de até R$ 13 mil para artistas de todo o Brasil.
articles.body:
Festival de Música Geraldo Azevedo em Petrolina abre inscrições — Foto: Deivid Menezes e Emerson Leite

As inscrições para o edital do Festival de Música Geraldo Azevedo, edição 2026, que será realizado em Petrolina , Sertão de Pernambuco, seguem abertas até a sexta-feira (4). Os interessados devem se cadastrar exclusivamente pela internet, por meio do site do Mapa Cultural (clique aqui) .

O evento será realizado nos dias 24, 25 e 26 de setembro, a partir das 19h. As apresentações vão acontecer na Concha Acústica, localizada na Praça Dom Malan.

A competição tem abrangência nacional e permite a participação de músicos, compositores, intérpretes e demais profissionais do segmento musical. O objetivo do festival é revelar novos talentos por meio de apresentações de músicas exclusivas.

Cada participante pode inscrever até duas canções, que devem ser obrigatoriamente autorais e inéditas. A organização vai selecionar as 20 melhores músicas com base nos seguintes critérios: letra, originalidade, estrutura textual, conteúdo, melodia, harmonia, arranjo e interpretação vocal.

Nos dois primeiros dias do festival, os 20 artistas selecionados farão suas apresentações, com dez shows por dia. Ao final dessa etapa inicial, dez participantes serão classificados para a grande final, que ocorrerá no terceiro dia de evento.

Na fase final, os candidatos serão avaliados para a definição dos três primeiros colocados e do vencedor da categoria de Melhor Intérprete. Todos os quatro premiados receberão troféus.

A premiação em dinheiro será de R$ 13 mil para o primeiro lugar, R$ 11 mil para o segundo colocado e R$ 9 mil para o terceiro. O vencedor da categoria de melhor intérprete receberá R$ 5.500.

articles.title: Rock in Rio realiza evento teste e anuncia show de drones | G1
articles.standfirst: A novidade foi anunciada por Roberta Medina, vice-presidenta do festival, durante uma coletiva nesta quarta-feira (2).
articles.summary: A novidade foi anunciada pela vice-presidenta Roberta Medina durante uma coletiva nesta quarta-feira (2).
articles.body:
O Rock in Rio realizou seu evento teste na tarde desta quarta-feira (2) e estreou a Cidade do Rock com novidades: haverá show de drones em quase todos os dias do festival, inclusive no show do Alok.

O evento está preparado para receber 100 mil pessoas por dia em seus 7 palcos e 100 ativações, com diversos brindes e brincadeiras — o que costuma gerar longas filas para quem quer aproveitar.

“Nosso foco é que a experiência seja mais importante do que o show ao qual você veio, do que o detalhe entre um show e outro, porque os artistas são nossos maestros”, destacou Medina.

O Palco Mundo, que é o principal, passou por mudanças de leds e cada artista poderá personalizar de acordo com a sua apresentação, o que promete dinamismo para o evento.

Roberta Medina, vice-presidenta do Rock in Rio — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

Durante o evento teste, houve apresentações do cantor Suel, Leo Janeiro & Simo not Simon, Detonautas convidam Biquíni e a atração de rua Kynnie.

A 41ª edição do Rock in Rio começa nesta sexta-feira (4) e vai até o outro domingo (13). O parque abre seus portões às 14h e fecha às 3h. O mais indicado é usar transporte público .

Uma outra novidade é um espetáculo imersivo que valoriza a Floresta Amazônica e tem momentos sensoriais durante a apresentação. São cinco sessões por dia da mostra Ecco.

Estão mantidos os shows de esquadrilhas que anunciam o início do evento e a queima de fogos.

Cidade do Rock — Foto: Thaís Espírito Santo/g1 Rio

articles.title: Filme maranhense “Ainda Te Amo” vence prêmio em festival de cinema | G1
articles.standfirst: Curta da Rodapé Filmes foi destaque na Mostra Brasil do Festival de Cinema de Caruaru, em Pernambuco, com trabalho visual assinado por Patrícia Moreira.
articles.summary: Curta da Rodapé Filmes foi destaque na Mostra Brasil do Festival de Cinema de Caruaru, em Pernambuco, com trabalho visual assinado por Patrícia Moreira.
articles.body:
Filme maranhense “Ainda Te Amo” vence prêmio de direção de arte em festival de cinema — Foto: Foto: Reprodução/rodaPé Filmes

O curta-metragem maranhense “Ainda Te Amo” conquistou o prêmio de Melhor Direção de Arte na 13ª edição do Festival de Cinema de Caruaru , em Pernambuco. A conquista foi divulgada na terça-feira (1º) pelos perfis oficiais do evento nas redes sociais. A direção de arte do filme é assinada por Patrícia Moreira.

O curta concorreu na Mostra Brasil, categoria que reúne filmes de temática livre produzidos em diferentes estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal, desde que sejam ambientados no Brasil e dirigidos por brasileiros.

O festival reuniu 39 curtas-metragens de várias regiões do país e também de países como Argentina, Peru, Colômbia, Chile e República Dominicana. As produções foram exibidas gratuitamente no Teatro João Lyra Filho, em Caruaru, com debates entre realizadores e uma cerimônia de premiação com entrega do Troféu José Condé.

Dirigido por Fernando Braga, “Ainda Te Amo” acompanha a trajetória de Mário, um homem marcado pela ausência e pelo abandono da mãe, que encontra na criação da personagem drag queen Keitty uma forma de reconstruir a própria história.

Além de roteirista, Fernando também interpreta o protagonista do filme. Ele explicou que a escolha pelo universo drag surgiu pela força estética e pelo significado simbólico dessa expressão artística.

“A drag não é apenas uma expressão artística, ela representa um processo de reconstrução emocional do protagonista”, afirmou.

Segundo o ator, um dos desafios da produção foi abordar o universo drag com sensibilidade, sem limitar a personagem à performance. “O filme fala sobre identidade, afeto, pertencimento e cura”, destacou.

Construção da protagonista de “Ainda Te Amo” foi marcada por desafios

Fernando contou que participar do desenvolvimento do roteiro ajudou na construção de Mário e Keitty, personagens que representam momentos diferentes da mesma trajetória.

“A intenção nunca foi fazer com que Keitty apagasse Mário. Pelo contrário. Mesmo durante a transformação, preservamos traços físicos e comportamentais que mantêm a essência dele presente”, explicou.

Para o artista, a relação entre as duas identidades é o ponto central da narrativa. “Keitty nasce de Mário e não existe sem ele”, disse.

O filme é uma produção da produtora maranhense Rodapé Filmes e busca provocar reflexões sobre abandono, amor, identidade e as formas encontradas pelas pessoas para seguir em frente.

“Ainda Te Amo” coloca o audiovisual maranhense em destaque

Para Fernando Braga, a premiação reforça o crescimento do audiovisual produzido no Maranhão e a presença de filmes do estado em festivais nacionais e internacionais.

“O Maranhão vive um momento muito importante para o audiovisual. A cada nova produção, mostramos que temos profissionais talentosos, histórias potentes e uma identidade própria de fazer cinema”, afirmou.

O artista destacou ainda que as conquistas ajudam a ampliar a visibilidade das produções maranhenses. “Estamos construindo um mercado cada vez mais forte e mostrando que nossas histórias têm qualidade, personalidade e capacidade de dialogar com espectadores de qualquer lugar do mundo”, completou.

articles.title: Eleições 2026: saiba como foi o dia do candidato André Luís ao governo do Maranhão | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidato do Missão fez campanha na Ceasa, em São Luís, e apresentou proposta que une gastronomia e manifestações culturais para incentivar o turismo no Maranhão.
articles.summary: Candidato do Missão fez campanha na Ceasa, em São Luís, e apresentou proposta que une gastronomia e manifestações culturais para incentivar o turismo no Maranhão.
articles.body:
Os candidatos ao governo do Maranhão cumpriram agendas de campanha nesta quarta-feira (2) com compromissos em São Luís e no interior do estado. As atividades tiveram como foco a apresentação de propostas para a área de cultura, além de entrevistas, panfletagem, reuniões políticas e visitas a comunidades.

A TV Mirante acompanhou os compromissos dos candidatos e registrou as principais propostas apresentadas por cada um ao longo do dia.

Veja, abaixo, como foi o dia do candidato André Luís (Missão)

André Luis (Missão) — Foto: Reprodução/ TV Mirante

André Luis, candidato pelo partido Missão, cumpriu agenda de campanha nesta quarta-feira (2) em São Luís. Pela manhã, ele esteve na Central de Abastecimento (Ceasa), onde entregou material de campanha e conversou com eleitores.

Durante a agenda, o candidato apresentou propostas para a área de cultura, que aparecem no plano de governo relacionadas ao turismo e ao desenvolvimento econômico.

André Luis afirmou que pretende criar o programa “Maranhão Sabor e Cultura”, com a proposta de unir gastronomia e manifestações culturais para incentivar o turismo no estado. Segundo o candidato, a iniciativa pretende valorizar expressões como o Bumba Meu Boi, o Tambor de Crioula, o Cacuriá e o Reggae.

“Para nós, a cultura é um poder de alavancagem da economia do nosso estado, por isso que o nosso plano chama-se Maranhão Sabor e Cultura. Nós queremos conectar a produção gastronômica também com a produção cultural para que o turista, quando vem para a cidade de São Luís, tenha atividade 365 dias no ano”, declarou.

O candidato disse ainda que pretende ampliar a divulgação das atividades culturais realizadas no interior do Maranhão e aproximar turistas da produção cultural do estado.

“Então, o nosso plano é abrir cada vez mais o que acontece na vida cultural no interior do nosso estado por meio desse planejamento, conectando cultura e gastronomia em todo o interior do nosso estado”, afirmou.

articles.title: ‘GDN’ OTT release date: When and where can we watch R Madhavan’s biographical film online?
articles.summary: R Madhavan’s ‘GDN’ is now heading to OTT after its theatrical run. The biographical drama will begin streaming on Netflix from September 4. The film w.
articles.body: R Madhavan’s ‘GDN’ is now heading to OTT after its theatrical run. The biographical drama will begin streaming on Netflix from September 4. The film will also be available in Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam, and Kannada, giving the story of inventor GD Naidu a wider audience across India. The streaming platform officially announced the release with the line, “Oru manushan oda vaazhkai indha naatu oda varalaaru (A man's life is the history of this country),” highlighting the importance of the man whose life inspired the film.‘GDN’ OTT release brings GD Naidu’s story to a wider audienceThe OTT premiere comes as the next major chapter for ‘GDN,’ which tells the story of one of Tamil Nadu’s most celebrated inventors. Directed by Krishnakumar Ramakumar, the film traces the journey of GD Naidu as he chases new ideas and innovations despite resistance from powerful authorities. His determination to move forward despite repeated obstacles forms the central theme of the story. With its digital release, the film now has an opportunity to reach viewers who may have missed it during its theatrical run.R Madhavan leads a strong cast in the GD Naidu biopicMadhavan plays the title role and has also backed the film as a producer along with his wife Sarita. The collaboration marks another biographical project involving the production house and the actor after the 2022 film ‘Rocketry: The Nambi Effect.’ ‘GDN’ also features Sathyaraj, Jayaram, Thambi Ramaiah, Priyamani and Dushara Vijayan in important roles.From a modest theatrical run to a new OTT journey‘GDN’ was released in theatres on August 7 alongside Arun Matheswaran’s DC, starring Lokesh Kanagaraj and Wamiqa Gabbi. However, the film did not achieve the expected results at the box office. According to a trade report by Sacnilk, it grossed around Rs 6.32 crore worldwide. While its theatrical journey remained limited, the Netflix release could give Madhavan’s film a fresh start. More importantly, the digital platform may bring renewed attention to the extraordinary life and legacy of GD Naidu, whose story remains at the heart of ‘GDN.’Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Suriya’s EXPENSIVE car collection: From BMW i7 to Range Rover, THESE are the luxury cars in ‘Vishwanath And Sons’ actor’s garage
articles.summary: Apart from acting and being a seasoned star of Tamil film industry, Suriya has made a name for himself through his fondness for expensive cars. In the.
articles.body: Apart from acting and being a seasoned star of Tamil film industry, Suriya has made a name for himself through his fondness for expensive cars. In the course of his life, the actor has assembled quite a collection of luxurious sedans, electric cars, and SUVs. His collection includes some of the biggest names in the automobile world, with models from Jaguar, Audi, Toyota, BMW and Land Rover. The reported prices of these cars also show the scale of Suriya’s luxury collection.Suriya’s luxury cars include Jaguar, Audi, and Toyota VellfireSuriya’s reported car collection begins with the Jaguar XJL, which is said to be worth around Rs 1.11 crore. The actor also owns an Audi e-tron 55 Quattro, reportedly priced at around Rs 1.25 crore. Another luxury car in the garage of Suriya is Toyota Vellfire VIP Executive Lounge with a price estimated at about Rs 1.50 crore. The MPV in question is known for spacious interiors and executive comfort; therefore, it is widely preferred by celebrities.BMW i7 and Range Rover complete Suriya’s high-end car collectionAt the higher end of Suriya’s reported collection are the BMW i7 and Land Rover Range Rover Vogue SE. The BMW i7 is estimated to cost around Rs 2.16 crore and adds an electric luxury sedan to his garage. The Range Rover Vogue SE is reportedly the most expensive car in the collection, with an estimated price of around Rs 2.47 crore. With these vehicles, Suriya’s garage covers everything from premium electric cars and executive sedans to luxury SUVs. The collection has also become an interesting part of the actor’s lifestyle profile among his fans.Suriya’s latest releases ‘Karuppu’ and ‘Vishwanath And Sons’ strengthen his comebackSuriya’s professional journey has also entered an important phase with his recent releases ‘Karuppu’ and ‘Vishwanath And Sons.’ ‘Karuppu,’ directed by RJ Balaji, marked a major theatrical outing for the actor and went on to become a box office success. The film’s performance helped Suriya regain momentum after a few setbacks. He was also seen in ‘Vishwanath And Sons,’ directed by Venky Atluri, which arrived in theatres on August 14. The film, featuring Suriya alongside Mamitha Baiju, Radhika Sarathkumar and Raveena Tandon, has added another successful release to his recent filmography.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: In 1994, Brad Pitt bought this HAUNTED Los Angeles mansion and loved it despite the strange activities; decades later, he sold the property for $39 million
articles.summary: In 1994, Brad Pitt bought a stunning haunted mansion in Los Angeles which he cherished despite its eerie reputation. Former owner Elvira shares her supernatural experiences in the house that led to the actor's fascination with its architectural beauty. Pitt sold the property for $39 million decades later.
articles.body: They say every house comes with its own story, and Brad Pitt’s former LA mansion was no different, except for one thing: this tale had supernatural characters. In 1994, Brad Pitt bought a beautiful Los Angeles mansion, and its history was not limited to architectural marvels. According to the former owner of the house, the one who sold the mansion to Brad Pitt, confessed that the property was HAUNTED! Interestingly, the ‘F1’ fame actor wasn’t kept in the dark and was told about the spooky reputation of the house. However, it seems Pitt doesn’t scare easily; if anything, it made him fall more for the LA mansion.What is the story behind Brad Pitt’s ‘haunted’ Los Angeles mansion?Pitt reportedly bought the LA mansion for $1.7 millions. Before Brad Pitt, the mansion was owned by Cassandra Peterson, best known as 'Elvira, Mistress of the Dark.' While speaking to PEOPLE in an old interview, Elvira shared that she warned Brad Pitt about the haunted mansion, but the actor was ‘very excited’ and, if anything, he ‘loved it.’"We were just kind of warning him that a lot of weird things have been going on there in the house since we moved in," Elvira said before sharing, "And he was very excited about that. He thought that was really cool."Elaborating further, she explained what she experienced at the house. "I've seen people walking around upstairs, for example, real people just walking. One time [a ghost was] sitting downstairs in front of the fireplace, once walking into my bedroom and back out," she recalled."We saw a person floating around at the bottom of the pool, things like that," Elvira said, sharing another incident.She knew her reputation always entered the room before her, and thus, she added, “"I know that sounds nutty. I'm Elvira. I know you expect that from me, right? I don't have hallucinations, I wasn't high and I can't explain those things."According to Elvira’s account, she and her ex-husband, musician Mark Pierson, experienced paranormal activities soon after they moved into the 29-room mansion. They called a priest to do an exorcism. “I had all kinds of things because it was really getting to a point of like, 'I don't know if I can continue to live here,’” she said.Why did Brad Pitt purchase a haunted house?The ‘Mr & Mrs Smith’ actor loved the architectural beauty of the place, and perhaps that is why he didn’t let the spooky tales scare him away. Elvira recalled, “So we were telling Brad all about that, and he loved it. I mean, there are not many buyers who that would be a selling point for, but he was like, 'Oh, that's so awesome.' I love that he appreciated the house so much. We got together like three times, I think, before he bought the house."According to Elvria, Brad Pitt was just the perfect buyer for the house because, "he's so interested in architecture and this house is just an exquisite house." The actor was in love with the solid mahogany wall panels and copper ceilings of the living room and dining room. He couldn’t get over them. If you ignore the supernatural squatters, "It was just a stunning house".Brad Pitt sold his ‘haunted’ house for $ 39 millionThe house was in rough condition, and thus, after the purchase, Brad Pitt made many renovations and even expanded the house by adding a new base. After all the redevelopment, in 2023, Brad Pitt sold the house. He had the ownership of it for nearly three decades. He was trying to unload the 1.9-acre property off-market for about $40 million.Give your child the gift of confidence! Claim your exclusive TOI Masterclass spot today!

articles.title: Nicolas Cage leads all-star cast in 'Fortitude,' a WWII film about the D-Day deception campaign
articles.summary: The first trailer for "Fortitude" showcases Nicolas Cage leading an all-star cast through WWII's greatest deception campaign ahead of D-Day.
articles.body: The first preview is out for the upcoming World War II film "Fortitude" with Nicolas Cage. Basic info: WORLD WAR II VETERAN REVEALS 1-WORD FEELING BEFORE D-DAY 82 YEARS LATER Trailer released for 'Fortitude' with Nicolas Cage As the loyal readers know, I am obsessed with WWII history. I even spent part of my honeymoon touring WWII sites in France, including heavily in the Normandy region. LAST SURVIVING 'ROSIE THE RIVETERS' HONORED BY WWII MUSEUM ON D-DAY ANNIVERSARY: 'WE CAN DO IT' I'm always going to be interested in any WWII movie that's coming out. It's not a tough sell. That leads me to "Fortitude" with Cage and Ben Kingsley. The first preview for the WWII film about Operation Fortitude was released Wednesday, and it looks like it's going to be electric. Give the preview a watch below, and let me know your thoughts at David.Hookstead@outkick.com. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK CULTURE COVERAGE For those who might not know, the Allies launched a massive deception campaign before D-Day aimed at convincing the Germans that the invasion of Western Europe would come through somewhere other than Normandy. Specifically, the Allies wanted the Germans to believe the main landing would be at Pas-de-Calais. In order to achieve this goal, the Allies employed several deception tactics, including making fake vehicles and phantom armies that didn't exist. In hindsight, it was one of the most brilliant moves in military history, and it helped give the brave men on the beaches in Normandy a better chance against the German forces tasked with holding the territory. Now, the story will come to life with Nicolas Cage leading the way in "Fortitude." OUTKICK IS NOW ON THE FOX APP: CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD The film is set to be released at some point in 2026, but there's no official release date yet. Let me know your thoughts at David.Hookstead@outkick.com.

articles.title: Pizza delivery man deserves a raise after walking past a black bear to deliver customer's order
articles.summary: Fontana Pizza Company shared video of their delivery driver calmly handing over a pizza order while a black bear stood just feet away in the yard.
articles.body: In a world where delivery drivers will show up to your door with your food and no clothes on or drop the food on the ground and scoop it back into the box as if nothing had happened, you want a delivery driver like this one. He's not letting a black bear hanging out in your front yard keep him from delivering your pizza. He's got balls of steel and a job to do. He should have also at the very least casually strolled back to his car with a hefty tip. That's at the very least. A nice raise from Fontana Pizza Company, who posted a video of their delivery driver dropping food off with a black bear feet away, would be appropriate if you ask me. CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE FROM OUTKICK OUTDOORS The video includes the text overlay "Our pizza delivery man really went above and beyond" and the caption "If our Delivery Driver can handle a Bear...imagine what we'll do to satisfy your Pizza cravings." It serves as a solid advertisement for the business. It’s also a solid advertisement for the delivery driver’s titanium cojones. The video shows the bear staring him down as he stands in the doorway and hands over the pizza order to the customers as if it's just another delivery. WILDLIFE PHOTOGRAPHER STAYS ICE-COLD AS MASSIVE BROWN BEAR WALKS RIGHT UP TO HIS CAMERA The bear eyeballs the driver as he casually walks back to his car parked at the end of the driveway, realizes he doesn’t have the pizza anymore and takes off away from the driver towards a tree in the front yard. Disaster was avoided. The bear went without pizza, but there was no attack on the delivery driver, and the family got the dinner they weren't willing to hop in their car and go pickup. They also got video of what could have very quickly turned into the mauling of a pizza delivery driver on their lawn. Another summer day in Fontana, California, evidently. articles.title: 'Entourage' creator Doug Ellin fires back at Debi Mazar's 'toxic' set claims
articles.summary: Doug Ellin calls Debi Mazar's claims about a toxic "Entourage" set "disgusting," insisting no one ever discussed her body or weight changes.
articles.body: Days after "Entourage" star Debi Mazar referred to the show's set as "toxic," creator Doug Ellin is pushing back. Over the weekend, Mazar — who portrayed straight-talking publicist Shauna Roberts across the HBO series' eight-season run — described the "testosterone-fueled environment" she encountered on set in an interview with The Sunday Times. Mazar also claimed that show executives "didn't like that [she] got fat" after the birth of her second child. On Tuesday, Ellin called Mazar's claims "disgusting" in a social media post. MAITLAND WARD SAYS SHE WAS 'SET UP' AND 'BETRAYED' BY 'BOY MEETS WORLD' CO-STARS IN TOXIC FALLOUT "My thoughts are this is disgusting. Never, ever did myself or anyone that matters care or discuss Debi Mazar’s body," he wrote on X. "I would one million percent embrace any woman who got pregnant. The only bodies on the show I ever commented on were Adrian’s ( I wanted him more muscular) and @jerryferrara who I wanted fatter. I will forever feel bad about that because I didn’t realize the health implications at the time and now couldn't be happier for Jerry’s transformation." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE In response to one user's post that sarcastically dragged the show for being "toxic," Ellin wrote, "Fu. It wasn’t. And you can ask 99 percent of the women who were on it, who are still good friends to this day." "There is no opinion. No one would have given a s--- about her weight. She was the publicist. She was not cast for her looks she was cast for her talent. Period," he wrote in response to another X user. A representative for Mazar did not immediately respond to Fox News Digital's request for comment. The actress reflected on her experience in the recent interview with The Sunday Times, calling the first season a "joy-fest" before saying the atmosphere shifted. 'BLUE BLOODS' STAR JENNIFER ESPOSITO SAYS SHE WALKED AWAY FROM HOLLYWOOD AFTER YEARS OF REJECTION AND ‘ABUSE’ "In the third season, the set was a testosterone-fueled environment," Mazar told the outlet. "I’m tough, but it got toxic towards the end for me." PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE Mazar, 62, said she returned to work after welcoming her second daughter and felt judged over her appearance. "They didn’t like that I got fat, even though I got skinny again," she said. The "Goodfellas" star said the situation was complicated in part because she has never been one to keep quiet about how she feels. Still, Mazar stressed that she remained professional and was grateful for her time on the series. "It was a lot of fun, until it wasn’t," she said. articles.title: Taylor Swift's husband Travis Kelce reveals what really happened at their 'insane' wedding
articles.summary: The Kelce brothers spill behind-the-scenes details from the Taylor Swift wedding at Madison Square Garden, from the guest list to the last call.
articles.body: Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift’s star-studded wedding was such a party that Jason Kelce joked guests had to be "kicked out" of Madison Square Garden when the night finally came to an end. More than a month after Travis and Swift tied the knot, the Kelce brothers detailed the over-the-top celebration on their "New Heights" podcast, spilling behind-the-scenes details about the couple’s ultra-private big day for the first time publicly. "They kicked us out," Jason quipped after Travis admitted the night went by in the "blink of an eye." TRAVIS KELCE CALLS MARRYING TAYLOR SWIFT AT MADISON SQUARE GARDEN 'THE BEST NIGHT OF MY LIFE' Travis quickly revealed what really happened, explaining that guests began filtering out once the drinks stopped flowing. "Well, they stopped – once the drinks stopped being served, everyone kind of just starts to, you know, mosey out," Travis said. Despite packing the iconic New York City venue with everyone from childhood friends to A-list stars, Travis said he and Swift wanted their wedding to feel surprisingly intimate. TAYLOR SWIFT AND TRAVIS KELCE'S WEDDING LEAKS SNOWBALL AS GUESTS REVEAL INSIDE DETAILS "We wanted to do it somewhere where we could have a very intimate and genuine setting without a lot of distractions," he said. "We needed it to be a private feel." Travis said MSG "went above and beyond" to pull off their vision – but he saved a particularly emotional thank-you for Adam Sandler. "He has been just the f---ing best person on this planet. And for him to be up for getting ordained in the state of New York and marrying me and Taylor in the way he did it. In the very, you know, Sandman style and giving us more than we could have ever imagined in that moment, knowing that it was the biggest night of both of our lives. It was, it was absolutely insane, man." Swift and Kelce married on July 3 in front of 1,000 guests at Madison Square Garden, a representative for the pop star told Fox News Digital. The two opted not to have a traditional wedding party, instead choosing to have Swift's brother as her "Man of Honor" and Kelce's brother as his "Best Man." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE Swift's rep revealed the couple's wedding ceremony looks were designed by Jonathan Anderson of Christian Dior Haute Couture. The "Life of a Showgirl" singer accessorized with Cartier and Christian Louboutin heels. "It was a joy to work with her," Anderson told WWD after the nuptials. "We became very good friends. It’s an emotional thing doing someone’s wedding." The guest list may have read like a Hollywood awards show, but some of the biggest surprises came from much closer to home. LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS Jason recalled watching Brad Pitt hug Conan O’Brien and spotting Paul McCartney among the crowd – only to get particularly excited when he recognized a familiar face from his past. "I saw Brad Pitt hugging Conan O'Brien, I see Paul McCartney and then, all of a sudden, I see, f---, Mrs. Clark," Jason said. "And I'm like, 'What in the world?'" For Travis, the unlikely mix of Hollywood heavyweights and longtime family friends was exactly what made the night so special. "It was so cool to see how everybody interacted," he said, explaining that people from his childhood mingled with Swift’s family, childhood friends and other people the couple had met. The phone-free celebration helped break down those barriers, according to Travis. "With no phones comes… people not having to be on guard... articles.title: Fox News Channel tops NBC, ABC and CBS in key ratings measurable for second straight summer
articles.summary: Fox News Channel delivered 13 of the 15 most-watched cable news programs among total day viewers in August as MS NOW and CNN struggled to compete across every daypart.
articles.body: Fox News Channel continued its dominance of the TV landscape in August, topping NBC, ABC and CBS in weekday primetime for the second consecutive summer while crushing cable news competitors in August. Since the start of summer, Fox News has averaged 2.6 million viewers during weekday primetime programming to beat NBC’s 2.5 million, ABC’s 2.3 million and CBS’ two million. While Fox News is outdrawing broadcast networks, it is also leaving other cable news outlets in the dust. In August, Fox News averaged 1.4 million total day viewers, while MS NOW managed 599,000 and CNN settled for 439,000. It was much of the same during the primetime hours of 8–11 p.m., as Fox News averaged 2.1 million viewers compared to 940,000 for MS NOW and only 624,000 for CNN. FIRST LADY MELANIA TRUMP, FOX CORPORATION ANNOUNCE LANDMARK STRATEGIC ALLIANCE TO GROW FOSTERING THE FUTURE "The Five," with Dana Perino, Greg Gutfeld, Jesse Watters, Emily Compagno, Jessica Tarlov and Harold Ford Jr., averaged 3.3 million total viewers to finish as the most-watched cable news program during August. "Jesse Watters Primetime" averaged 2.9 million viewers to take the primetime crown. "Gutfeld!," "Special Report with Bret Baier," "Hannity" and "The Ingraham Angle" all finished with larger audiences than anything MS NOW or CNN had to offer as Fox News delivered 13 of the 15-most-watched programs on cable news. The highest-rated MS NOW program, "The Rachel Maddow Show," which only aired four times the entire month because its namesake host is on a Mondays-only schedule, finished sixth. FOX NEWS DIGITAL THUMPS ALL NEWS BRANDS, INCLUDING BROADCAST NETWORKS, IN KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS DURING JULY CNN’s top-rated program was "CNN Newsnight," which finished No. 24 among cable news offerings. Meanwhile, "FOX & Friends" finished August with 1.2 million viewers to remain the No. 1 cable news morning show in both categories for the 66th consecutive month, beating CNN and MS NOW combined in the process. "America’s Newsroom with Bill Hemmer and Dana Perino," "The Faulkner Focus," "Outnumbered," "America Reports with Sandra Smith and John Roberts," Martha MacCallum’s "The Story" and "The Will Cain Show" all thrived as Fox News’ daytime lineup continued to dominate. CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE OF MEDIA AND CULTURE Fox News also continued to shine throughout the weekend in August, defeating CNN and MS NOW in both total viewers and the key demographic of adults age 25-54. "Saturday in America with Kayleigh McEnany" was the most-watched show on Saturdays with 1.4 million viewers, while "Sunday Morning Futures" and "Sunday Night in America with Trey Gowdy" averaged 1.4 million viewers apiece to share the Sunday title. Data courtesy of Nielsen Media Research. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP

articles.title: Mel Gibson reveals ‘The Passion of the Christ’s’ most surprising legacy in new Raymond Arroyo interview
articles.summary: Mel Gibson says "The Passion of the Christ" sparked real crime confessions and Christian conversions, as he now prepares a massive two-part sequel.
articles.body: More than two decades after becoming a box-office hit, Mel Gibson’s "The Passion of the Christ" is returning to theaters nationwide as the Oscar-winning director prepares to tell the next chapter of the biblical story. Gibson spoke exclusively with Fox News contributor Raymond Arroyo about his upcoming two-part sequel, "The Resurrection of the Christ," reflecting on stories of real-life crime confessions and faith transformations he said were inspired by the original film, as well as the pre-release pushback it faced. The full interview is featured on the "Arroyo Grande Show with Raymond Arroyo" YouTube channel. MEL GIBSON'S 'RESURRECTION OF THE CHRIST' REVEALS FIRST PHOTOS AFTER LONG-AWAITED PASSION SEQUEL "I just wanted to make it as real as possible for people to enter into that journey, which is pretty grueling," Gibson told Arroyo about the 2004 film. "And previous depictions of it had been pretty much sanitized, and they made it look easy, and it wasn't. So, I wanted to emphasize that this was not easy. In fact, he didn't want to do it." "The Passion of the Christ" is a biblical drama depicting the crucifixion of Jesus Christ in excruciating detail. It starred Jim Caviezel as Jesus and focused on the final 12 hours of Jesus’ life, with dialogue mainly in Aramaic, Hebrew and Latin. HOLLYWOOD PRODUCER BEHIND 'APOLLO 13' REJECTS POLITICS IN HIS MOVIES, SEEKS TO UNITE AUDIENCES At the time, the film faced significant pushback before its release over its violence, religious themes and concerns that it could fuel antisemitism. Gibson told Arroyo he believes those fears did not materialize and that the film instead brought some people together. "It didn't do that at all, which I was pleased with," Gibson said. "Because people were like pointing at me and yelling at me, and it didn’t spawn any violence." GEN Z FLOCKING TO CATHOLIC CHURCHES IN NYC FOR YOUTH GROUPS, SOCIAL EVENTS AMID CONVERSION BOOM Instead, Gibson said he heard stories of people converting to Christianity or confessing crimes after seeing the film. He recalled one person confessing to bank robberies and another who "confessed to a murder." Beyond the film’s impact on individuals, it also helped reshape the entertainment landscape by demonstrating an audience for faith-based media. It went on to gross more than $610 million worldwide and has remained popular with Christian audiences. AMERICA ISN’T DONE WITH JESUS — AND THE BESTSELLER LIST JUST PROVED IT "Well, because people wanted it," Gibson explained when asked why the film resonated so deeply. "I think there was a hunger for it, and they went to see it in droves. And then I think others realized that there was a place where they could share their visions. And then there was zeal amongst faith-based people and filmmakers to explore it further." "The Passion of the Christ" returns to theaters Sept. 10 through Sept. 17. Gibson is also returning to the story of Jesus with a two-part sequel about what happened after the crucifixion and the resurrection of Christ. NEW BOOK ON ARCHAEOLOGICAL EVIDENCE FOR JESUS ROCKETS TO TOP OF BESTSELLER LIST "The Resurrection of the Christ: Part One" is set for release May 6, 2027, with Part Two scheduled for May 25, 2028. The first film focused on the final hours of Jesus’ life, while Gibson said the sequel requires a larger spectacle to depict his resurrection and the days that followed. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP For Gibson, telling the story of the Resurrection is essential because he views the Crucifixion as only part of the larger narrative. "It's not the climax," Gibson said. "It's a part of it. And it's a big event for sure. But the really astounding part of it is that someone can come back to life under their own strength and power from public death and then be public again after that."

articles.title: Lady A's Charles Kelley shares before-and-after photos showing how sobriety transformed his life
articles.summary: Lady A's Charles Kelley shared striking before-and-after photos on Instagram, crediting sobriety for his transformation after years of alcoholism.
articles.body: Lady A's Charles Kelley is sharing how his life has changed since starting his sobriety journey. In an Instagram post shared Monday, the 44-year-old musician shared photos from before and after he began his journey with sobriety, crediting his decision to stop drinking with his healthier appearance. "My best filter is just…not drinking," he wrote in the caption. "Swipe to see my before 😬 my wife asked me if I ever look at a photo of myself before I was sober and think 'who is that guy?' This is the one 😃." The before photo shows him looking dazed as he posed for the selfie, while the after picture shows him posing for a photo with his wife while out on the water. COUNTRY SINGER MARK CHESNUTT SAYS ALCOHOLISM 'ALMOST KILLED' HIM, ADMITS HE DRANK A HANDLE OF VODKA A DAY He added in the caption that there have been countless "blessings that have come from putting it down" in addition to "looking healthier," noting that the second photo is "a nice reminder of a place I don’t wanna go back to." Many fans congratulated him in the comments section and shared their experiences with alcoholism and sobriety. "I’m 1,148 days sober today! So proud of you! I know it’s hard but so worth it! 👏👏👏" one fan wrote. Another added, "Ahhh yes, the puffy drinking face! 4 years sober and I hope I never have to see that puffy face ever again! Proud of you 👏." Kelley's journey with sobriety first became public knowledge in August 2022, when Lady A shared with its fans that it was postponing its Request Line Tour to support him. LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "We are a band, but more importantly we're family," they said in a statement at the time. "⁣⁣We're proud to say that Charles has embarked on a journey to sobriety. So, right now, in order to be the healthiest, strongest and most creative band we can be, Lady A will take the time with the support of our families and team of professionals to walk through this together. It's early on this road, but we are determined to do what will best set us up for many more years together." He later discussed his decision to get sober during an appearance on "CBS Mornings" in May 2023, saying he would always joke that he was "definitely a functioning alcoholic." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE The musician shared that as his drinking continued to become concerning, his bandmates brought their concerns to him, but he pushed them aside. He ultimately decided to seek help after his wife threatened to leave him if he didn't quit drinking, leading him to fly from his vacation in Greece to a treatment center. "It just makes me feel so grateful at how close I came to losing it all," he said. "And I think the thing that’s hard is to know how much it affected Cassie the most, and my band and the people around me. And how much it emotionally kinda wrecked them for a while. And that, I can’t really say I’m sorry enough. And it’s just gonna take time to rebuild that." Kelley shared that he had attempted to quit before but didn't think he needed rehab because he believed that was for people with more serious problems with alcohol. What he learned, however, is that there are different "degrees of alcoholics" and that "just because you're not living on the street, or you're not waking up in a bush" doesn't mean there isn't a problem. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE Ultimately, the musician stayed in rehab for one month and credited group therapy, a case manager and a blood alcohol detection device that he would blow into twice a day for aiding his recovery. "I went to treatment for a month in Utah, and I really didn't know if I was ever going to be coming back home to my bed," Kelley told People in June 2025. "And that was tough. I'd written a lot of songs about heartbreak, but I don't know if I ever really knew what heartbreak felt like until I was there and had that moment." CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP

articles.title: Anna Wintour reportedly faces calls to retire after John Galliano Met Gala firestorm: ‘Lost her touch’
articles.summary: Anna Wintour faced fierce backlash over the scrapped John Galliano Met Gala exhibition, with insiders reportedly demanding she take more accountability.
articles.body: Anna Wintour found herself at the center of a fashion firestorm after plans to celebrate disgraced designer John Galliano at the Met Gala unraveled. Scrapping the planned 2027 exhibition devoted to Galliano's work did little to quiet the criticism, with fashion industry insiders telling the New York Post that Wintour should face greater scrutiny over her role in the project. "I wish Anna would take more accountability," an insider told the New York Post. "She is the person who wanted this to happen, never fully considering the consequences,’’ the source said. "She is the public face and reaps the benefit of the gala and the surrounding coverage. MET GALA BACKLASH GROWS AS CELEBRITIES AND POLITICIANS TARGET JEFF AND LAUREN BEZOS' SPONSORSHIP "Why does she only get to reap the rewards and not face more criticism?" Red carpet expert Melissa Rivers told Page Six Style, "Anna Wintour is brilliant, but people rarely say no [to her]. And, in the past, she’s made some mistakes of not reading the room correctly." Rivers said her late mother, Joan Rivers, "would have hated" a Galliano-themed Met Gala but admitted she was a fan of his designs. "He was such a force of nature in fashion and design. … Is it a great time to honor his work? Unfortunately, no, not a great read of the room," she said. At the heart of the Met Gala backlash was Galliano’s troubled past. Galliano, long recognized as one of the fashion world’s biggest talents for his creatively flamboyant designs, was at the pinnacle of that world for years as the creative director of Christian Dior. He was fired in 2011 after a series of racist and antisemitic remarks he made in 2010 and 2011 surfaced and went viral, leading to his conviction in an antisemitism trial in France. Among the remarks Galliano made to bar patrons and circulated on video was the statement, "I love Hitler." He also told Jewish patrons that their mothers and forefathers would have been "gassed." He also made derogatory comments to an Asian patron. After he was dropped by Dior, Galliano spent several years working to rehabilitate his image and career. He made a comeback in 2014 when he was hired by Paris fashion house Maison Margiela, where he remained for a decade. KIM KARDASHIAN, BEYONCE AND BLAKE LIVELY STEAL THE SHOW AT THE 2026 MET GALA However, putting him at the center of the Costume Institute's 2027 exhibition brought new scrutiny for Vogue's former editor-in-chief. Others defended Wintour, arguing the decision had extended far beyond her. "People seem to think she’s the sole person [making decisions about the Met theme]," a source told the New York Post. "It’s a huge amount of people on the Met board that signed off on this. She’s a piece of that. "It wasn’t her decision alone, by any stretch of the imagination. This exhibition … people have been speaking about it for at least a couple of years," the source added. "It was a big group decision. It’s a team effort. Not just her." Responsibility for approving the exhibition may have stretched well beyond Wintour, but Galliano appeared to make one thing clear: The decision to kill it was his. "After much reflection and discussion with The Met and all those involved, I have decided, with great sadness, that it is best for the exhibition not to take place at this time," he said in a statement shared by The Met. "I remain fully accountable for the pain caused by my words in the past, particularly the hurt I caused to the Jewish and Asian communities, and I remain deeply sorry for it. "I understand that meaningful atonement is not achieved through an exhibition, institutional recognition or a single public gesture. It is a continuing responsibility, demonstrated through listening, learning and one’s conduct over time." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE The Costume Institute's curator in charge, Andrew Bolton, also addressed the controversy, saying he supported the decision after extensive discussions. "I believe deeply in the responsibility of museums to examine difficult histories with rigor, candor and care," he said. "I also recognize the pain and concern this exhibition has caused. After extensive discussion, I support the decision not to proceed. I remain deeply grateful to my colleagues and to the advisors, lenders, collaborators and community leaders who contributed their knowledge, trust and perspectives to the project." Galliano took responsibility, and Bolton acknowledged the pain the exhibition had caused, but some fashion industry insiders continued to criticize Wintour. The longtime fashion power broker released her own statement, which did not include an apology. "John's decision that the exhibition devoted to his work should not take place at this time is very courageous and a measure of the man he is," she said in a statement released Monday. "I believe this is the right decision, and both he and the Museum have my full support." "It’s too late for an apology – she should retire," one insider told the Post. LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS Wintour "doesn’t understand what people are talking about and thought she could shoulder through this, and it would blow over," another source said. "Anna’s lost her touch on the zeitgeist," the source said. Yet insiders said Wintour’s backing of Galliano grew out of her belief in redemption and second chances. Her support for Galliano as the original choice for the 2027 Met Gala wasn't necessarily a surprise. "It comes from a place of love and forgiveness," an insider told the outlet. "She really believes in people’s second chances and becoming better people and learning from mistakes. It came from a good place. She considers him a friend and wants what’s best for him." PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE "Anna is a big proponent of second chances and getting behind the underdog," another source said. The source pointed out that Wintour brought Georgina Chapman back into the fashion fold after the #MeToo movement focused attention on allegations against her then-husband, Harvey Weinstein, encouraging people to wear her designer brand, Marchesa. The insider added, "There is no question Galliano is talented. "To let him come back is one thing," the source noted. "But to celebrate him on such a scale, especially when antisemitism is at its highest … it sends all the wrong messages. But Anna is very loyal to the people she is loyal to." articles.title: Wife of Bala farmer who fell into slurry pit says workers face stress
articles.summary: Margaret Owen says "things are getting worse" after a rise in deaths of workers on British farms.
articles.body:
The widow of a farmer who died after he fell into a slurry pit has spoken about the stresses facing workers after a rise in deaths.

Margaret Owen said the impact of husband Islwyn's death had been brought back to her once again following reports that a father and son had died in similar circumstances last week.

She said Islwyn had worried about bad weather and recently-introduced rules on slurry spreading when he had fallen at his farm in Bala, Gwynedd, in 2024.

Latest figures from the Health and Safety Executive (HSE) show 22 workers died on British farms during 2025-26 - the highest number in a decade.

Margaret said the number of deaths had made it appear "things are getting worse and worse".

An inquest into Islwyn's death found he had fallen into the slurry pit after he had climbed on to a short wall to adjust some machinery at Cefn Bodig farm in Llanycil, Bala.

He suffered asphyxia along with serious injuries to his right arm and chest caused by the machinery, and his body was found by a neighbour 90 minutes after he was reported missing on the evening of 4 September 2024.

Islwyn was pronounced dead at the scene, and his death was ruled as accidental.

Margaret said that, although it had not been the cause of his death, Islwyn had been under pressure because of a combination of bad weather and the Welsh government's rules that banned farmers from spreading slurry between mid-October to January.

She said that farmers in general are often under a lot of stress.

The ban on muck-spreading over winter months to protect rivers is something that Wales' environment minister Llyr Gruffydd has said he wanted to change after Plaid Cymru came into power.

"The weather had been wet and there was a problem with mixing the slurry and emptying the slurry before the cattle came in - it was quite a stressful situation," she told BBC Cymru Fyw.

The deaths of Alan Ford, 72, and his son Rick, 42, after they had fallen into an industrial slurry tank at a farm in Chester on 26 August, had brought back memories of her husband's death, she said.

The 22 deaths of workers on farms in Wales, England and Scotland during 2025-26 was the highest in a decade, and second only to the number of deaths of those working in construction (27), according to HSE figures.

But the rate of farm deaths was seven times higher per 100,000 workers, and 21 times more likely than the all-industry average.

"It seems that things are getting worse and worse", Margaret said, and that "four [people] within four miles of here have died in recent years - it's scary isn't it?"

"Islwyn was so careful - one of those rare farmers who wore a helmet," she said.

"He was aware of the dangers of farming and I kept saying 'be careful'."

She said she had known something was wrong on the day Islwyn died "because he was never very late for dinner", and said the nature of his death had been "hard to accept".

Margaret had to sell their farm stock and arrange for other farmers to rent the majority of their land.

"For over a year I had tears coming every day, and I thought I'm going to be like this forever. But it's getting easier," she said.

She had stayed in Llanycil and said it had been "important to focus on the nice memories", keeping herself busy by keeping horses.

articles.title: Trump says Harry and Meghan treated royals with ‘great disrespect’: ‘I wouldn’t have taken them back’
articles.summary: President Trump says he's "happy" Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are leaving the U.S., claiming the couple disrespected the royal family.
articles.body: President Donald Trump on Wednesday told reporters he was "happy" to see Prince Harry and Meghan Markle leaving the United States because he felt the couple had disrespected the royal family. "I'm happy about it," Trump said in the Oval Office to laughter after a reporter asked for his reaction to the Duke and Duchess of Sussex moving their family back to Britain. "No, I was not a fan." The president added that he "had a very good relationship with the queen. Really good. I got to know her very well." PRINCE HARRY, MEGHAN MARKLE’S UK MOVE PUTS FRESH SPOTLIGHT ON THEIR EXPLOSIVE CLAIMS AGAINST ROYAL FAMILY He said he has also known King Charles III for a "long time" and had a "really good relationship" with the current monarch. "He's great, great guy," the president said. LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "And I thought they treated the royal family with great disrespect," Trump said. "I didn't like it. I didn't like the way they acted. I thought she was terribly disrespectful to the queen, to King Charles," he said, referring to Markle. articles.title: Elliot Page claims no acting offers arise after 'The Odyssey,' hints transition may be why
articles.summary: Elliot Page says he has received no new acting offers after "The Odyssey," suggesting Hollywood now views him differently since his transition.
articles.body: Transgender actor Elliot Page revealed Thursday on the "On Film... with Kevin McCarthy" podcast that acting offers had dried up after appearing in Christopher Nolan's blockbuster "The Odyssey," suggesting casting had become more difficult because Hollywood viewed him differently after his transition. Page reflected on the difference between his career before and after publicly coming out as transgender in 2020, suggesting he may need to take a more proactive role in developing projects and approaching filmmakers. "I was seen in a certain way before, and it’s different now," he said. "So maybe there is something to reaching out to people and trying to create projects that way. But it’s a little tricky for me to get cast now, for obvious, pretty obvious reasons." "The Canadian thing," Page joked. TRANS ACTOR ELLIOT PAGE ARGUES 'HEALTHY MASCULINITY' IS REJECTING EXPECTATION TO 'SHUT DOWN' Lisa Cusack, president of the Don’t L.A. My Burbank PAC, told Fox News Digital on Wednesday that Hollywood’s broader financial pressures should push studios away from political messaging and back toward entertainment audiences want to see. "Hollywood might skew as left as it gets, but the industry is struggling right now and can’t afford to push woke politics that lose at the box office," she said. "Maybe the silver lining is the industry will get back to basics." "People pay to see their dreams and aspirations, not someone else’s woke delusions," she added. GLAAD RELEASES 'PARTICULARLY CONCERNING' REPORT SHOWING SHRINKING LGBTQ REPRESENTATION THIRD YEAR IN A ROW Page said the lack of offers had not diminished his desire to continue acting and described feeling more comfortable performing since his tradition. "I feel like I could maybe do some of my best work now," he said. "I’ve been so lucky in my career and gotten to play some really fantastic parts and be a part of some wonderful projects." Page, 39, played Greek soldier Sinon in Nolan's "The Odyssey," reuniting with the filmmaker 16 years after appearing in "Inception." Page’s casting in "The Odyssey" had already generated controversy before the film reached theaters. Fox News Digital reported in July that critics targeted several of Nolan’s casting decisions, including Page as Sinon, Lupita Nyong’o as Helen of Troy and rapper Travis Scott as a Greek bard. STEEP DECLINE FOR MINORITY AND FEMALE LEADS IN FILM, UCLA HOLLYWOOD DIVERSITY REPORT FINDS Despite the pre-release controversy, "The Odyssey" became one of 2026's biggest theatrical successes. The movie had grossed more than $1.5 billion worldwide by early September, according to published box-office figures. The success came amid a complicated year for the broader movie business. Reuters reported in August that domestic box-office revenue reached $6.2 billion through Aug. 2, a 15% increase from the same point in 2025 but still below 2019 levels. Ticket sales, however, remained sharply lower than before the pandemic, with 470.9 million tickets sold compared with 747.3 million during the comparable 2019 period. articles.title: The NBA suspends Steve Ballmer for a year and takes five draft picks over the Kawhi Leonard scandal.
articles.summary:
The NBA has announced penalties from its investigation into cap circumvention allegations around the Clippers, Kawhi Leonard, and a string of companies that inked shady “endorsement” deals with the star: Aspiration, Daktronics, Boingo Wireless, and Lockton Insurance, as detailed in a report from the law firm of Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz.
There are also fines ($30 million for the Clippers, $700,000 for Leonard), suspensions for two team execs and Leonard’s uncle, and the investigation is apparently ongoing.

articles.title: Brooke Shields makes a splash in black swimsuit during action-packed Croatia trip
articles.summary: Brooke Shields shared stunning waterfall photos and a daring jump video from her adventure-filled Croatia vacation with Chelsea Handler on Instagram.
articles.body: Brooke Shields found her "highlight of the summer" on an adventure-filled getaway to Croatia. The 61-year-old actress and model shared highlights from a trip with friends, including Chelsea Handler, that took her from the streets of Croatia to waterfalls and the open water. Shields kicked off the Instagram carousel with a striking photo of herself sitting beside a rushing waterfall in a black strapless one-piece swimsuit. HEATHER GRAHAM SIZZLES IN WHITE BIKINI DURING SOUTH OF FRANCE GETAWAY Soaked from the rushing water, Shields sat back on a moss-covered rock with her legs stretched out in front of her, closing her eyes and lifting her face toward the sun. Her dark hair was slicked back as she finished the strapless black swimsuit look with a gold chain necklace and bracelets. "Highlight of the summer: the most amazing trip to Croatia with the best people 🇭🇷😍🏝️," Shields captioned the Instagram post. KATE HUDSON SHOWS OFF FIT BODY IN MULTIPLE STRING BIKINIS DURING FAMILY VACATION IN GREECE Another photo captured Shields enjoying a sunny day on the water with Handler and another friend. Shields stretched out on a wooden swim platform attached to a boat while wearing the same black one-piece. Handler, 51, sat nearby in a turquoise swimsuit, while another woman smiled from the water in a red bikini top and patterned bottoms. IVANKA TRUMP SHARES INTIMATE LOOK AT COOL-WEATHER ICELAND GETAWAY WITH JARED KUSHNER AND THEIR KIDS The longtime friends appeared to make the most of their time together throughout the trip. Shields and Handler have been friends for years. The two previously appeared on each other's podcasts and spoke candidly about their lives and relationships. Away from the water, Shields traded her swimsuit for a bright yellow dress while exploring Croatia with Handler. The "Pretty Baby" star paired the loose-fitting dress with a wide-brimmed straw hat, layered necklaces and a brown belt. Handler stood beside her in a white button-down shirt, patterned skirt, navy baseball cap and dark sunglasses as the two smiled for the camera on a busy street. GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE Shields wasn't afraid to get adventurous during the getaway either. In a video included in the carousel, she jumped from the edge of a rushing waterfall into the water below while wearing her black one-piece. Fans filled the comments with praise for both Shields and her picturesque destination. "Croatia is beautiful 😍," one person wrote. "Brooke Shields The most beautiful in the world😍😍," another commented. "What a fun trip! ❤️," another fan added. One commenter joked about Shields' waterfall excursion, writing, "So that’s the fountain of youth you’ve been using!" The carefree vacation comes months after Shields reflected on the work she has done to remain grounded after spending virtually her entire life in the public eye. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE During a July 2026 conversation with Oprah Winfrey for Oprah Daily, Shields spoke about navigating fame since beginning her modeling career as a baby. "You either become a victim to it, and you resent it, and then you get angry, and you get bitter," Shields said, "or you say, ‘OK, how can I not be devoured by this? How can I surround myself with people who are grounded?’" Shields said maintaining that sense of normalcy became particularly important when she became a mother to daughters Rowan and Grier with husband Chris Henchy. "How can I stay as grounded as possible to be the kind of mom for my daughters that it would very easily be derailed in this industry?" she told Winfrey. Shields' own relationship with her mother, Teri, was far more complicated. Teri raised Shields as a single mother and managed her career from childhood. Shields told Winfrey the two became so intertwined that there was little room for her to develop an independent identity. LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "There was so much love, but then you couple that with the industry that we were in," Shields said. "She protected me fiercely." The actress also reflected on how years of therapy have helped her distinguish her own voice from the influence of her late mother and longtime manager. "Luckily, I hear — I’ve worked so hard on myself — to hear my own voice in my head first," Shields said. "And that’s years of working on it and therapy and thinking about it and talking about it and making myself sort of freer from this." CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP
